rules.interaction: Complements M.G.L. c.151B state source-of-income protection (not named in this page).
rules.title: Boston fair housing rule: rental assistance (vouchers) is a protected class
rules.requirement: Boston landlords may not refuse or treat applicants differently because they use rental assistance such as Section 8, disability or veterans vouchers.
rules.key_value: no discrimination based on rental assistance (Section 8 vouchers)
rules.citation: Boston Fair Housing Commission, Boston Fair Housing Regulations
